+from recipe_scrapers.tastykitchen import TastyKitchen
+from tests import ScraperTest
+
+
+class TestTastyKitchenScraper(ScraperTest):
+    scraper_class = TastyKitchen
+
+    def test_total_time(self):
+        self.assertEqual(15, self.harvester_class.total_time())
+
+    def test_canonical_url(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            "https://www.thepioneerwoman.com/food-cooking/recipes/a11059/restaurant-style-salsa/",
+            self.harvester_class.canonical_url(),
+        )
+
+    def test_title(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.harvester_class.title(), "Restaurant Style Salsa")

+import unittest
+from recipe_scrapers._utils import get_minutes
+
+
+class TestUtils(unittest.TestCase):
+    iso8601_fixtures = {
+        "PT1H": 60,
+        "PT20M": 20,
+        "PT2H10M": 130,
+        "PT0H9M30S": 10,
+    }
+
+    def test_get_minutes_handles_pau_pum(self):
+        text = "Pá-Pum"
+        self.assertIsNone(get_minutes(text))
+
+    def test_get_minutes_returns_none_if_no_time_is_present(self):
+        text = "This recipe takes some time"
+        self.assertIsNone(get_minutes(text))
+
